seoPage.title: Do EVs Catch Fire Easily? Myth vs Reality | EVSavari
seoPage.metaDescription: Do EVs Catch Fire Easily? Myth vs Reality — practical ownership guidance for Indian buyers.
seoPage.intro: The myth: EVs are inherently fire-prone. The reality: thermal incidents get disproportionate attention; causes are often investigated case-by-case — safety still requires proper repair and charging practice.

editorialSections.title: The myth
paragraphs: High-profile fire videos create fear. All cars carry energy — EV incidents are visible in media but not the whole ownership story.

editorialSections.title: Practical reality
bullets: Use authorised service for battery or high-voltage work.
Avoid damage to the pack from scrapes or unauthorised modifications.
Follow recall and software advisories from the brand.

editorialSections.title: Limitations
paragraphs: When incidents occur, causes matter — charging setup, collision damage, or defects. Blanket fear is not a buying method.

misconceptions.myth: Every EV is one spark away
misconceptions.reality: Millions of km are driven daily — media highlights rare events.

misconceptions.myth: Home charging is always the cause
misconceptions.reality: Investigations vary — certified install reduces risk.

faq.question: Are EVs less safe than petrol?
faq.answer: Roadworthy EVs meet safety standards — risk depends on use, damage, and maintenance.

faq.question: Can I park in sun?
faq.answer: Normal parking is fine — follow OEM guidance for extreme heat.

faq.question: Should I avoid fast charging?
faq.answer: Use DC when needed — follow brand guidance.

faq.question: What after a crash?
faq.answer: Insurer and authorised workshop assessment — do not ignore pack inspections.
